summary: Understand what counts as regulated promotional work and what RagTag does not do.

sections.heading: Regulated promotional work
paragraphs: Regulated promotional work is agency support for materials that promote prescription products to healthcare professionals or consumers under client MLR rules.
Typical deliverables include copy, layout, claims support, reference packages, and timeline planning — not regulatory approval.
bullets: Rx promotion is distinct from unbranded disease awareness.
The client medical-legal-regulatory (MLR) team owns approval for use.
RagTag helps plan, draft, and organize work; it does not approve materials.
